title: CORE-7000 · "BEST VALUE" ribbon missing drop-shadow (1024/1800)
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7000](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7000/rf-shared-best-value-ribbon-missing-drop-shadow-on-clone-10241800) · state `In Progress` · priority P4

## Ticket (verbatim from Linear)

**Page:** `/` (homepage)
**Component:** Formation Packages — "All Inclusive" card, diagonal **"BEST VALUE"** corner ribbon
**Breakpoints:** **1024 & 1800** (the ribbon only renders as a diagonal corner banner at these widths; at 360 & 768 there is no ribbon on either site — N/A)

## Issue

On live, the diagonal BEST VALUE ribbon casts a soft **drop-shadow** onto the card beneath it. On the clone the ribbon is **flat** — no shadow.

## Expected (Live) vs Actual (Clone)

|  | Expected (Live) | Actual (Clone) |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Ribbon `box-shadow` | `rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0px 5px 10px 0px` | `none` |

*(ribbon colour, size, angle and text all match — only the shadow is missing)*

## Definition of Done

* BEST VALUE ribbon carries `box-shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0 5px 10px` (or a visually matching shadow) at **1024 & 1800**, matching live.

## Evidence

Ribbon corner, Live vs Clone (live casts a soft drop-shadow onto the card; clone is flat):

| Breakpoint | Live | Clone |
| -- | -- | -- |
| **1024** |  |  |
| **1800** |  |  |

*(360 & 768 omitted — no diagonal ribbon renders on either site at those widths.)*

---
### Routing note (Planning)
`rapid-formations-clone` has **no clone engine** — no `walk-dom-cdp.ts` / `emit-block.ts` /
`verify-clone.ts`, and zero `*Clone` blocks. Every block here is hand-authored, so the
engine-first rule has nothing to diagnose into: this is a **direct fix in the block that
has the defect**. That is why the task is tagged `bug` — it is NOT a fidelity loophole.

**Ship path:** Mode X — `clone-pull-request-create` with per-breakpoint PROD-vs-clone
screenshot proof, land `awaiting-user`, **the USER merges the PR**. Never merge to main.
Live source of truth: `https://www.rapidformations.co.uk` · clone:
`https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app`. ⛔ HEADED browser only for any visual check.
acceptanceCriteria: BEST VALUE ribbon carries `box-shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0 5px 10px 0` (or a visually matching shadow) at 1024 and 1800, matching live (clone currently `none`).
Ribbon colour, size, angle and text are unchanged — they already match live.
No ribbon is introduced at 360 or 768, where neither site renders the diagonal corner banner.
PR carries PROD-vs-clone screenshot proof of the ribbon corner at 1024 and 1800.
